extract_inputs_targets_forcings: extract inputs, targets, and forcings from an xarray dataset by variable names, pressure levels, and time windows
extract_input_target_times: extract input and target datasets from an xarray dataset given an input duration and target lead times
add_derived_vars: add year progress and day progress sin cos features to an xarray dataset in place
add_tisr_var: add top of atmosphere incident solar radiation feature to an xarray dataset in place
featurize_progress: derive sin and cos transformed xarray variables from a progress numpy array for ML model features
